contract.citations_and_derivations.mathe.reason: The Pauli energy term has the wrong temporal Wilson-factor sign. With the paper's transformation ψn→exp(iqαn)ψn and A0→A0+(αn+1−αn)/Δt, exp(+iqΔtA0)ψn†σBψn+1 acquires exp(2iq(αn+1−αn)); it is not gauge invariant. The conjugated link factor is required. The code repeats this error. Temporal-gauge magnetic results remain unaffected, but the general mathematical conservation statement is invalid.
